items.label: la pharmacie
items.scene: A grandma peers through a brass telescope to SEE ("fahr-mah-SEE") the PHARMACY's green cross from FAR away, and finds it right here.

items.label: l'ordonnance
items.scene: A patient waves his PRESCRIPTION and does a happy DANCE ("NAHNS") on the tiles.

items.label: la médecine
items.scene: A little girl is SEEN ("SEEN") bravely swallowing her spoonful of MEDICINE, pulling a face.

items.label: le pharmacien
items.scene: The PHARMACIST in a white coat hands cough drops to a FARMER ("fahr-mah-") whose cow sneezes beside him.

items.label: le médicament
items.scene: A tiny MAN ("MAHN") in a toy CAR ("kah") drives a box of MEDICATION across the counter to a waiting hedgehog.

items.label: le sirop
items.scene: The pharmacist's helper pours cough SYRUP ("see-ROH", the p is silent) for a ROW of three sniffly ducklings.

items.label: le remède
items.scene: A grandma brings her home-MADE ("ruh-MEHD") REMEDY: a steaming mug of honey and lemon.
